AAP MP Raghav Chadha's Name Removed From Draft Voter List in Punjab

Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) Member of Parliament Raghav Chadha's name has been removed from the draft voter list in Punjab. Chadha stated that the AAP government is taking revenge. Senior Congress leader P. Chidambaram commented on the removal, suggesting Chadha was not alone and questioning the Election Commission. Amar Ujala provided an explainer on how names can be removed from voter lists and how to re-register as a voter, even after an 'SIR' process, using Chadha's case as an example.
